title: Cluster operability playbook + timeline canvas for Private Console
creator: Elena Morales
description: Design a consolidated operability canvas for Private/VPC clusters that combines timeline-driven upgrade/maintenance plans, actionable status cards, cost exposure annotations, and rollout controls. The goal is a single surface for SREs and tenant owners to: visualize recent degradations, plan and simulate upgrades, see cost spikes tied to ops events, and trigger controlled rollouts (canary, stage, rollback) with safety gates. UX must scale from single-cluster detail to multi-cluster summary while maintaining clear action affordances and audit trails.
comments: 2025-02-13 - Kickoff: PM (Julian Park) scoped acceptance criteria: must surface per-tenant egress/cost exposure, show last 30d event timeline, and integrate with rollout API. Action: design to produce low-fidelity canvas + interaction spec.

2025-02-18 - Research: Interviewed 4 SREs and 3 account owners. Key pain: upgrade windows often scheduled without clear cost estimate impact; operators want to ‘simulate’ an upgrade and see cost delta and risk signals before scheduling. Added simulation mode to scope.

2025-02-21 - Design review with Eng (Priya Nair): alignment on data availability. Eng noted no precise per-tenant cost model at 1h granularity; suggested sampling and bounded estimates. Decided to include conservative ranges in cost annotations and link to detailed cost breakdown panel.

2025-02-24 - Prototype 1 completed (Figma): compact timeline + expandable cluster cards + simulated rollout drawer. Shared for stakeholder feedback: link: https://figma.redwood.com/file/priv-console-operability/DES-654321
2025-02-25 - PM feedback: Add audit trail export (CSV) and quick link to incident runbooks. UX team to add copy for exported events and include incident tags in timeline.

2025-02-27 - Design iteration: Introduced 'Safety Heat' band above timeline that aggregates SLO breach probability, recent failover counts, and egress spike risk. Discussed visual encoding trade-offs: line chart vs heat band. Chose band for compactness and multi-metric overlay.

2025-02-28 - Security review triage: Security flagged KMS key rotation ops exposure. Action: add permission gating on rollout CTA and a small modal showing required roles. Marked security_review_required = true.

2025-03-01 - Hand-off to Eng: Provided interaction spec and component checklist. Raised follow-ups: server endpoint for simulated-cost, backend flag for canary policy enforcement, audit log webhooks. Created GH issue links in attachments.
2025-03-01 - Design QA notes: microcopy updated to reflect conservative cost ranges; added hover affordance on timeline points with link to raw logs (via Log Explorer).
